fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohort 2 (NSCLC): Participants who should have received no more than 3 prior lines of therapy and: those without oncogene-driven tumors: Have progressed within 12 weeks after last dose of anti-PD-1/PD-L1 blocking antibody those with oncogene-driven tumors: Have progressed during/after >=1 targeted therapy AND either: platinum doublet chemotherapy Or within 12 weeks after last dose of anti-PD-1/PD-L1 blocking antibody
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy requirements depend on cohort type and molecular profile with multiple alternative branches, which cannot be expressed as a single typed check.
